ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Label D refers to which cycle in the diagram?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a diagram of the mosquito life cycle. At the top of the diagram is an adult mosquito, labeled E; near the water surface on the right side is a group of eggs, labeled B; in the water below is a slender, hairy larval form, labeled A; in the water at the lower left is a curled, comma-shaped stage, labeled D beside it. The red arrows indicate that these stages change cyclically in order. Reasoning: The form labeled D is located after the larva and before the adult mosquito, and is curled and comma-shaped; this is the pupa stage in the mosquito life cycle. Therefore, D refers to pupa.
